rule: Last-bit: finite numeric mismatches <=16 ULP; larger numeric: >16 ULP. This split is triage, not a relaxed verdict. Every mismatch, refusal, unread, missing, pending, external and circular-policy cell remains an inclusive failure. Corpus labels follow exact single-cell aliases, infer calls from formula spelling and unwrap INDEX selections; unresolved references and infix operators remain explicit. Bank functions use canonical judge identities. Counts are observations per source; corpus and bank may overlap and must not be added as unique calls. Bank reference/locale context gaps remain failures, not proven numerical defects. Rows are ordered by corpus mismatch count, then corpus larger differences, then bank nonpasses.
